_arch_note: exp_g_0026 (1.1949408, 68,237,580 params, the 8-heads x 128-tables untied winner) with ONE change: head_lut true -> ONE additional CompressionMHL sub-layer at the end of the trunk, immediately before the unembedder. Shape mirrors an FFN slot exactly: x = x + head_ffn(head_ln(x)), then logits = head(ln_f(x)); pre-norm + residual, decompress zero-initialized so the layer is the identity at step 0. Its LUT hyperparameters are IDENTICAL to the FFN slots' (all lut_* fields below: n_heads 8, tph 128, nap 7, inner_in 48, inner_out 48, forward_mode hard, learnable_temps true), only random_seed differs (lut_base_seed + depth = 1006, so it does not collide with the 6 FFN-slot seeds 1000..1005). Everything else held: depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, seq 512, vocab 32768, 16,000 steps, 24,576 tok/step, untied head, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, seed 1. NOT parameter-matched -- the extra slot ADDS params (LUT tables + compress + decompress + one LayerNorm); the question asked is how much bpb the extra layer buys, not whether it is free. Anchors: exp_g_0026 1.1949408 (direct parent), exp_n_0083 1.1892311 (untied, 2048 tables/slot), exp_n_0045 1.1977670 (tied baseline).
_mem_note: device_batch_size 24 / grad_accum 2 inherited unchanged from exp_g_0026 (effective batch 24,576 tokens identical). The extra CompressionMHL adds a 7th LUT slot worth of backward-surrogate activation, ~1/6 more LUT activation memory than exp_g_0026; verified by a real forward+backward smoke before launch.
